comment: RM coverage of every golden client at every month-end (Account Planning, mv_rm_engagement; Apr-2024 to Sep-2026, from the month the relationship started): the primary RM and relationship tier in force, activities in the month and in the trailing 90 days, distinct contacts met, average note sentiment, the last contact date and the touched / not-touched-in-90-days flags. Rows exist for clients with no activity at all, so "Strategic clients with no RM contact in the last 90 days" is a filter on the latest month (is_latest_month) and is_strategic_not_touched_90d. The 90-day counts are trailing windows: never sum them across months. Grain: one row per golden client x month-end (dense from the relationship start).
